commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+9' The corner is swung in but Wolves can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+8' Great touch by Joao Gomes (Wolves) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
90+7' Kevin Danso (Tottenham) has tested the patience of referee Anthony Taylor and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+6' Joao Gomes (Wolves) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.

67' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) takes the free kick and curls the ball just over the crossbar. That was close!

62' Roberto De Zerbi decides to make a substitution. Yves Bissouma will be replaced by Joao Palhinha (Tottenham).

55' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
55' A yellow card for bad language! Pedro Porro (Tottenham) couldn’t remain silent and the result is obvious.
54' Richarlison (Tottenham) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
52' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) fails to keep his cool and squanders a golden chance to score from inside the penalty area after firing the ball over the crossbar.
47' Wolves can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
46' That will be all from Randal Kolo Muani who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Mathys Tel (Tottenham).

45+4' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
45+3' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Andre (Wolves) was quite harsh and Anthony Taylor didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
43' Wolves take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
40' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Dominic Solanke limps off the pitch to be replaced by Richarlison (Tottenham).
38' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
37' Adam Armstrong (Wolves) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
32' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
29' The resulting set piece from Wolves is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
28' A quickly taken corner by Wolves.

19' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) tries to find Djed Spence, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
14' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
12' Randal Kolo Muani (Tottenham) takes a snap shot on the edge of the box, but it sails well wide of the right post.
10' The Wolves players are exchanging some short passes.
8' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.
8' Randal Kolo Muani (Tottenham) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The referee signals a corner kick to Tottenham.
6' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Xavi Simons (Tottenham) takes it short.
4' It looks like Joao Gomes (Wolves) saw red with that tackle. Anthony Taylor won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
